observations.observation: COV configuration converts requested voltage/hysteresis in 50.6 mV increments and delay in 3.3 ms increments, constrains register values, writes them and replaces configuration fields with the represented values. CUV has related quantization and is explicitly enabled because it is not enabled by default.
observations.interpretation_limit: Assigning represented values to the configuration object is not a register readback or proof that the write/physical protection succeeded. The function return code must also be checked.

observations.observation: The data-memory interface waits/retries, validates payload length and checksum, returns an error on exhausted readiness checks or bad checksum, and writes checksum plus length with payload.
observations.interpretation_limit: Code-level retry constants do not establish measured driver WCET or end-to-end shutdown time.

observations.observation: Repository tests cover CUV default/minimum/maximum/outside-range register encoding; tests also inspect balancing idle-current scaling and signed current/temperature conversions.
observations.interpretation_limit: These are inspected mocked-register tests. They were not run in this research and are not physical AFE/comparator tests.

observations.observation: The BMS C1 board description declares BQ76952 at I2C address 0x08, a 16-channel mask, NTC mappings and a 300 micro-ohm shunt; the CAN transceiver capability and configured bus rate are distinct declarations.
observations.interpretation_limit: Board metadata is not measured performance or proof that the separately pinned hardware/firmware revisions form a validated combination.

observations.observation: The firmware manifest refers to Zephyr with the moving v4.4-branch revision, while the ThingSet SDK is identified by a complete commit SHA.
observations.interpretation_limit: A pinned firmware repository commit alone does not freeze all dependencies.

planned_adoption.question: How does an engineering threshold become an applied AFE setting?
planned_adoption.level: Independent numerical model plus mocked-register test; hardware readback and injected protection tests are separate later work.
inputs: Named AFE revision and authoritative register specification; independently chosen request/encoding fixtures.
Illustrative encoding-only fixture: 4.2 V COV, 4.1 V reset, 100 ms delay, plus minimum, maximum, half-step and invalid-input cases.
procedure: Validate range and finite values before conversion; calculate register codes, quantization error and represented thresholds.
Compare writes against an independently calculated table; check write error propagation; distinguish represented configuration from verified hardware readback.
Separately specify scan phase, decision delay, bus retry, command and physical interruption time in an end-to-end budget.
expected_evidence: For the illustrative fixture, code 83, hysteresis code 2, delay code 30; represented values 4.1998 V, 4.0986 V and 99 ms, subject to the pinned AFE register semantics.
Requested value, encoded register, represented value, returned status and explicit readback status remain separately labelled.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: No mismatch to independently computed expected encodings; invalid inputs are handled by the teaching implementation contract; no physical trip-time claim from a numerical/mock test.

planned_adoption.question: What does a failed or delayed AFE transaction do to data quality?
inputs: Ready response; delayed readiness; permanent not-ready; transport error; invalid length; invalid checksum.
procedure: Inject one condition at a time using a deterministic bus trace.
Record attempt count, termination reason, elapsed model time, returned status and whether sample sequence/time/quality changed.
expected_evidence: An unsuccessful transaction cannot be presented by the teaching adapter as a newly valid complete measurement.
Timing evidence separates bus transfer duration, polling delay and scheduler overhead.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Every declared failure branch produces its declared error/data-quality outcome; measured target WCET remains a distinct pending experiment.

planned_adoption.question: Can a second reader reproduce the same dependency set?
inputs: Pinned firmware SHA; board target and overlay; resolved Zephyr and module SHAs; toolchain and build command.
procedure: Freeze the complete dependency manifest and record toolchain versions.
Build and run only the scoped emulator/mock tests in an isolated workspace.
expected_evidence: Dependency lock, command log, selected test output and known exclusions.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Another reader can reconstruct the declared dependency graph; a build or emulator pass is not relabelled as board validation.

observations.observation: The native BQ76952 schematic has revision 0.4.2 and date 2026-03-29. Structural parsing identifies the placed BQ76952, cell-input resistor/capacitor populations, cell labels, current-shunt ports, charge/discharge controls, NTC ports and I2C/ALERT nets.

sources.section: title_block and root-level placed symbol/label/hierarchical_label nodes; excluding lib_symbols definitions

observations.interpretation_limit: Only structural inventory was reviewed. Wire geometry, complete connectivity, RC topology, creepage, tolerances and netlist were not verified.

observations.observation: The checked BOM identifies R45 as a 300 micro-ohm Kelvin shunt and U4 as BQ76952PFBR; the shunt nominal agrees with the separately checked firmware board-description value.
observations.interpretation_limit: Matching one component nominal is not a compatibility or measurement-accuracy validation of the pinned firmware/hardware pair.

planned_adoption.question: Can a reader trace one physical measurement and one protection action through actual design artifacts?
planned_adoption.level: Versioned schematic/netlist/BOM review; later low-energy cell-simulator bench work is separate.
inputs: Hardware revision and assembly BOM; firmware SHA; board-description/overlay SHA; relevant AFE and shunt datasheet revisions.
procedure: Trace terminal -> input components -> AFE pin -> raw register -> engineering unit -> validity flag.
Trace a protection threshold from requirements through quantization and enable bits to intended CHG/DSG output and observed feedback.
Review Kelvin pick-off locations and selected/optional components; separately document any unresolved connectivity or thermal assumptions.
expected_evidence: An annotated trace table with artifact revision, component references, raw code, unit conversion and unresolved assumptions.
A compatibility matrix for the exact assembly/firmware/overlay combination.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Every claimed node has source evidence; no rating, RC time constant, physical action or accuracy is inferred only from a parts inventory.

planned_adoption.question: What makes a hardware test report reusable without transferring its conclusion to another revision?
planned_adoption.level: Test-record contract; target bench execution remains pending.
inputs: One named DUT revision and firmware/parameter hashes; isolated low-energy setup; calibrated equipment records; explicit limits and abort conditions.
procedure: Create case IDs with requirement, injection, expected observation, actual observation, instrument trace, pass/fail and exclusions.
Compare the report DUT with the proposed textbook DUT; record all revision and parameter differences.
expected_evidence: A filled case for each actually performed check and a separate pending list.
No reuse of upstream pass marks as local evidence.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Version/conditions/results trace to the same DUT; missing equipment or execution stays pending.

observations.observation: This architecture delegates load-current/power limiting to the power consumer; BMS charge disconnection and a separate main fuse cover different responsibilities.
observations.interpretation_limit: This is a particular application responsibility split. Do not generalize its application-specific risk statements into a universal battery-safety claim.

observations.observation: The implemented status byte sends is_charging at bit 0, is_balancing at bit 1, charge_allowed at bit 2 and charge_ok at bit 3; receive code decodes the latter two separately. Nearby comments and README retain an older bit map.
observations.interpretation_limit: A protocol name or README table alone is insufficient to establish the pinned implementation layout; sender/receiver implementations and external compatibility must be checked.

observations.observation: The receiver records local arrival time, not the source sample time. A selected low-voltage peer value has a 10-second expiry path, while peer-cache IDs are reclaimed after 10 minutes.
observations.interpretation_limit: Cache reclamation and safety data freshness are distinct contracts. No claim is made that all upper-layer data-freshness handling has been audited.

observations.observation: bms_if_get_soh is explicitly TODO and returns 1.0. README states SOH estimation is unimplemented and reads 100 percent.
observations.interpretation_limit: A populated SOH field is not evidence of capacity/power SOH estimation or estimator accuracy.

observations.observation: Charge permission checks use voltage/temperature bounds and peer states. Charging and non-charging voltage limits differ; a charge-overcurrent path latches charge disallow until the charger-detection condition clears.
observations.interpretation_limit: Do not generalize one charger-unplug latch path to every fault without tracing each branch.

observations.observation: Thermal derating reduces simultaneous balancing channels; the reduction loop chooses a lower-voltage currently balancing cell to disable, despite a nearby comment using the word highest. XML exposes independent limits for channel count, charge voltages and balancing temperatures.
observations.interpretation_limit: Comments and UI parameter ranges are not authoritative operational validation; XML initial values are not verified runtime values or recommended thresholds for another cell chemistry.

observations.observation: The LTC6813 sampling loop reads non-muted values, mutes balancing, waits 10 ms and reads muted values. An Open wire check block is commented out. Read groups are accepted only when their PEC matches.
observations.interpretation_limit: The presence of commented diagnostic code is not executed open-wire coverage. A failed group may leave older values while other groups update; complete upper-layer validity handling was not audited.

observations.observation: ADC-ready polling has a 1500 ms timeout break in a void function; the particular PEC implementation has its own seed, polynomial and output convention.
observations.interpretation_limit: A polling timeout limit is not nominal conversion time. Do not substitute a generic course CRC16 for this PEC convention or claim a vulnerability without tracing callers and validity handling.

planned_adoption.question: Do protocol state semantics survive independent encode/decode tests and stale input?
planned_adoption.level: Independent host-side packet fixtures and deterministic clock; no CAN hardware execution in this research.
inputs: Pinned sender/receiver definitions; all four charge_allowed/charge_ok combinations; signed temperature and scale boundaries; dropped, repeated, malformed and delayed packets.
procedure: Independently tabulate expected byte values and compare serialization and decoding.
Label source sample time, receive time and age as separate concepts; simulate expiry just below/at/above the selected timeout.
Keep peer-cache retention independent from whether values may authorize an action.
expected_evidence: Golden byte table, decoder outcomes, state transitions and freshness timeline.
SOH placeholder explicitly labelled unavailable rather than used as estimator output.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Every named bit and unit matches the pinned implementation contract; arrival of duplicate stale data does not falsely prove a new source measurement; timeout semantics are explicit.

planned_adoption.question: Can partial AFE failure be represented without calling a mixed snapshot complete and new?
planned_adoption.level: Independent AFE adapter model with injected group-level PEC/status outcomes.
inputs: All groups valid; one group bad PEC; consecutive failures; ADC never ready; open-wire function absent/disabled; balancing on/off.
procedure: Track per-group value sequence, timestamp, quality and aggregate completeness.
Specify handling of timeout, retained old values and partial updates; measure any target execution separately.
Use the exact documented PEC parameters only after checking authoritative chip documentation and known vectors.
expected_evidence: Group-quality table and deterministic event log, with explicitly pending physical open-wire and thermal tests.
planned_adoption.pass_rule: Teaching implementation never labels stale/partial values as a new complete snapshot, and no disabled diagnostic is counted as executed coverage.

planned_adoption.question: Which component must react when charging or discharging becomes impermissible?
planned_adoption.level: Responsibility/state-machine review; physical disconnection and thermal validation remain separate.
inputs: Architecture responsibility table; charge bounds and hysteresis; charger-detection state; peer permission; balancing channel count and temperature.
procedure: Run independent state tables for local/peer charging permission and the specific overcurrent latch path.
Trace responsibility for load limiting, charge switching and fuse interruption.
Exercise thermal channel-limit boundaries without treating XML UI defaults as cell-specific safe settings.
expected_evidence: Cause -> local state -> transmitted state -> responsible actuator -> observed feedback table.
